outcome: composite neonatal adverse outcome (large for gestational age, Apgar score <5 at 5 minutes, assisted ventilation >6 hours, neonatal seizure, neonatal death)
composite maternal adverse outcome (admission to intensive care unit, transfusion, uterine rupture, unplanned hysterectomy)
cohort: The cohort consisted of individuals with pregestational or gestational diabetes who delivered between 2016 and 2019 in the United States.
finding: Among individuals with diabetes, lower education levels were associated with a modestly higher risk of adverse neonatal and maternal outcomes.
